_readme: Site glossary for the Woow n8n Onboarding Guide en/ root. shared = WoowTech series names and chrome terms reused across the sites; terms = n8n domain terms (n8n's own English UI and docs wording wins); keepEnglish = never translate or rephrase; forbid = words the reviewer rejects. decisions = the binding cross-page wording agreed before the 25 pages were translated in parallel: every recurring h2, every data-nav label, callout labels, table headers, the Chinese strings inside frozen code blocks (proposal-only), recurring prose, chapters.json strings and the localize substitutions.
principles: Upstream English UI/docs wording wins (headscale.net, tailscale.com/kb).
Product names, CLI commands, config keys, file names, hostnames and placeholders stay verbatim; Chinese placeholders become <your-…> style.
US spelling; sentence case for headings, nav and buttons; Title Case for product and WoowTech series names.
Second person 'you'; direct, like a senior engineer onboarding a beginner; no 'In this chapter we will', no marketing adjectives, no emoji.
Callout labels are fixed: Concept: / Tip: / Warning: / Danger:; full-width punctuation becomes ASCII; 第 N 章 → Chapter N; 圖 N-M → Figure N-M.
n8n's own English UI wording wins (docs.n8n.io and the editor labels): Executions, Credentials, Templates, Edit Fields, Loop Over Items, Run once for each item.
Node names, parameter labels, expression syntax, environment variables and JSON keys are UI/code strings: keep them verbatim and in the source's capitalization.
'n8n' is always lowercase, even at the start of a sentence or heading; 'workflow' is one lowercase word; 'sub-workflow' keeps its hyphen.

shared.把重複工作外包給流程自動化: Hand your repetitive work over to automation

terms.n8n: n8n (always lowercase, even at the start of a heading)
terms.Woow n8n: Woow n8n (WoowTech's own self-hosted n8n; never 'the Woow n8n')
terms.Canvas / 畫布: canvas (lowercase in prose; Canvas only when it is the UI label)
terms.工作區: workspace — the editor area; capital-W Workspace only for the settings layer in Appendix A
terms.跑一次 / 手動跑 / 手動測: run it once / run it manually / manual test
terms.逐筆 / 一次全部: run once for each item / run once for all items
terms.Expression / 表達式: expression in prose; Expression when it is the UI mode or field
terms.SSL 憑證: SSL certificate (this one really is a certificate)
terms.金鑰: key (API key); secret when it is a client secret
terms.授權: authorize / authorization; OAuth consent when it is the consent screen
terms.卡關: pitfall (in a heading); get stuck (as a verb)
terms.System Prompt / 系統提示: system prompt (System Prompt when it is the field label)
terms.時區: timezone (one word, as in the n8n UI)
terms.分頁: tab (in the UI) / pagination (in HTTP Request) — decide per sentence, never one word for both
terms.打 API / 打進來: call an API / call in (hit your webhook)
terms.綁定: bind (a workflow to an error workflow) / point at
terms.顆: measure word — drop it: 'a node', 'an instance', not 'a piece of'
terms.版本: version; edition when it is Community / Cloud / Enterprise
terms.地圖: map (the mental map of the UI)

forbid: drawer (for 節點抽屜 — it is the nodes panel)
certificate (for credential — only SSL 憑證 is a certificate)
Line (as the product name — it is LINE)
Function node as a current node (it merged into Code node in v0.198.0)
example (for 實例 when it means the n8n server — that is 'instance')
flow (as a short form of workflow)

decisions._readme: Binding cross-page wording. If a page can render a phrase two ways, use the form here. h2_exact lists every distinct <h2> in the zh root because they must not drift; data_nav lists every data-nav attribute (<= 3 words each); code_placeholders is proposal-only (code is frozen); localize applies only to units whose policy.json entry is localize or transcreate.

h2_by_section.why: chapter-specific: translate the Chinese h2 literally. Do NOT replace it with 'Why this matters' — that is the data-nav label only.
h2_by_section.concept: chapter-specific: keep the Chinese metaphor (Lego, doorbell, compartments, map) instead of flattening it into a generic 'Core concepts'.
h2_by_section.steps: Hands-on: <what you build>  — 動手做／動手／實作 all become 'Hands-on:'; keep the Chinese numeral (十一個步驟 = eleven steps, 五個步驟 = five steps).
h2_by_section.troubleshoot: 常見卡關 = Common pitfalls; <topic>常見卡關 = Common <topic> pitfalls; 常見卡關與怎麼救 = Common pitfalls and fixes; 常見狀況排除 = Troubleshooting; 常見錯誤排除 = Common errors and fixes; 卡關救援 = Getting unstuck.
h2_by_section.faq: FAQ — always exactly 'FAQ'. The zh is always 常見問題; never add a topic word the source does not have.
h2_by_section.compare: chapter-specific comparison. 'X vs Y' keeps the source order and lowercase 'vs' (no 'versus', no comma).
h2_by_section.advanced: chapter-specific. 進階 = Advanced only when the source says 進階.
h2_by_section.sources: n/a — this site has no 官方來源 section. Do not invent one.
h2_by_section.symptom pattern (appendix B): 症狀 N：X → Symptom N: X — keep the number and the source order.

localize.X-Line-Signature: X-Line-Signature (frozen — it is a real header name)
